title: BERTAQA: How Much Do Language Models Know About Local Culture?

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model accuracy on the BERTAQA multiple-choice trivia dataset by evaluating the performance difference between a subset of questions focused on local minority culture (Basque) and a subset focused on global or anglocentric topics.

Evaluating and comparing model performance on the exact same set of multiple-choice questions when prompted in a high-resource language (English) versus a low-resource language (Basque), as well as testing translation-based approaches.
